historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Zoning Administrator's decision on the conditions placed on the granting of a variance for the property at 720 Presidio Avenue, the vote to overrule falling short of the required four votes.

The Board of Permit Appeals, on rehearing, overruled the Zoning Administrator and granted the variance for the property at 720 Presidio Avenue, with stipulations about landscaping, planting, and sprinklers.
